mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_contents (post_id, content_type, content_value, sequence) VALUES (#{post_id}, #{content.type}, #{content.value}, #{content.sequence})
INSERT INTO post_tags (post_id, lang_code, tag_name) VALUES (#{post_id}, #{tag.langCode}, #{tag.tagName})

INSERT INTO time_slots (slot_id, schedule_id, available_time, status, max_capacity, booked_count) VALUES (#{slot.id}, #{scheduleId}, #{slot.time}, #{slot.status}, IF(#{slot.maxCapacity} > 0, #{slot.maxCapacity}, 10), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id, p.user_id, p.title, p.subtitle, p.price, p.discount_rate, p.duration, p.max_participants, p.rating, p.review_count, COALESCE(w.cnt, 0) AS like_count, p.city_name, p.country, p.lat, p.lng, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.course_additional_description FROM posts p LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM wishlists GROUP BY post_id) w ON p.post_id = w.post_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET title = #{title}, subtitle = #{subtitle}, price = #{price}, discount_rate = #{discount_rate}, duration = #{duration}, max_participants = #{max_participants}, city_name = #{city_name}, country = #{country}, lat = #{lat}, lng = #{lng}, course_additional_description = #{courseAdditionalDescription}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{post_id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM review_likes WHERE review_id IN (SELECT id FROM reviews WHERE post_id = #{postId})
DELETE FROM review_images WHERE review_id IN (SELECT id FROM reviews WHERE post_id = #{postId})
mapper.select: SELECT image_url FROM post_images WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY image_id ASC
SELECT content_type AS type, content_value AS value, sequence FROM post_contents WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY sequence ASC
SELECT schedule_id AS scheduleId, available_date AS date FROM post_schedules WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY available_date ASC
SELECT slot_id AS id, available_time AS time, status, max_capacity AS maxCapacity, booked_count AS bookedCount FROM time_slots WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} ORDER BY available_time ASC
